<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Imperious Aura](/Feats.aspx?ID=4202) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

**Prerequisites**
one or more [stance](/Traits.aspx?ID=152) [impulses](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) that affect your kinetic aura

**Trigger**
Your turn begins.

</column>

---

Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements. Use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.
